name: APPEAL_GRV_TAT_MILESTONES
description: This table holds information about turnaround time milestones for appeals and grievances. Each row corresponds to an individual milestone and the date and time associated with the milestone.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the appeal/grievance record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: TAT_TIME_STANDARD_C_NAME
columns.description: The timeliness standard category ID that corresponds to this milestone.

columns.name: TAT_MILESTONE_C_NAME
columns.description: The milestone type category ID for this milestone.

columns.name: TAT_MILE_INST_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time associated with this milestone. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: TAT_MILE_DUE_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time associated with this milestone.
